meta.name: Broken Episodes Fixture (Play/episodes test)
meta.description: Device-test fixture for invalid episode identity data. The leading videos have missing/invalid season or episode values (the crash case fixed in 0.4.x); later videos are valid. From Details, Play should skip malformed entries and resolve a playable episode without crashing. In Episodes, valid episodes should open streams normally and malformed entries must not crash actions.

videos.title: Broken: episode null (reported crash shape)
videos.overview: Has a canonical id but episode is null; resolution must remain safe and id-first handling should still work where possible.

videos.title: Broken: episode missing, no id
videos.overview: No episode field and no video id. This was the Details Play crash case (invalid episode passed to typed resolver).

videos.title: Broken: season null, no id
videos.overview: Season is null and there is no video id, so the episode cannot be addressed.

videos.title: Valid: canonical id + ordinals
videos.overview: First fully addressable episode. Details Play should resolve to this (or another valid entry) without crashing.

videos.title: Valid: ordinals only (fallback build)
videos.overview: No explicit video id; resolver should derive tt9000001:1:5 from valid season/episode.

videos.title: Valid: season 2 episode 1
videos.overview: Another valid episode in a different season.
